Lovable does have an official expert directory, though one third-party source says otherwise.

- **Official directory:** Lovable's Partner Program includes Experts: Independent builders and small agencies who create software for clients. and a Partner Directory: A new way for organizations to discover and hire Experts and Solution Partners.
- **How to get listed:** Lovable's expert page says the program lets experts get discovered by clients in the partner directory. The Expert track is for individual freelancers and agencies under five people building websites, apps, and internal tools for clients on Lovable. Applicants go through an application form, and the Thai version of the page describes an approval, Academy training, and assessment process before the Certified Lovable Expert badge is granted.
- **Conflicting source:** A RapidDevelopers guide states that no official, verified 'Lovable experts' marketplace exists on lovable.dev as of September 2026. It suggests finding people through the community Discord, freelance platforms, and agencies, and vetting their actual work instead of relying on a badge or listing. This conflicts with Lovable's own pages, so the directory may have launched recently.
- **Directory listings:** A Unico Connect guide says the directory lists each member with a hired count and hourly rate, and it names Weekend Inc as the most-hired member. That is a third-party claim, and the guide itself notes it is not a directory member.
- **Other marketplaces:** MentorCruise also lists Lovable experts, but its pages are generic marketing copy, and the claim that its experts are "pre-vetted" is unverified.

To hire, check Lovable's partners/experts page for the current directory, then review each candidate's shipped work before engaging them.

The Lovable Partner Program has two agency-relevant tracks, plus a directory for hiring.

- **Structure:** Lovable's blog describes three components: Experts: Independent builders and small agencies who create software for clients. Solution Partners: Agencies, consultancies, and systems integrators that deliver larger or more complex solutions. A separate Partner Directory helps organizations find and hire partners (4-12).
- **Applying:** The partners page lets you apply to either track, and says that if you're unsure, you can apply and we'll recommend the right one. You can also switch tracks as your business changes.
- **Benefits:** A trade publication reports three main perks: revenue share, matchmaking with enterprise buyers, and Lovable credits for building client projects (2-3). It notes that Lovable has not disclosed specific commission structures.
- **Traction:** Lovable says 500+ Solution Partners including Deutsche Telekom and KPMG have signed agreements and begun certification ahead of this launch.

Note that the Solution Partner benefits come from a third-party write-up, not Lovable's own announcement, so verify current terms on lovable.dev before committing.

QUERY: Lovable partner program launch revenue share commission experts solution partners | MODE: extended | DOMAINS: none | DATE: 2026-10-21
Links: lovable.dev/partners/solution ; partner-program-rules.lovable.app/solutions-partner ; partner-program-rules.lovable.app/ ; lovable.dev/partners/experts ; solutions-partner-program-rules.lovable.app/ ; createwith.com/tool/lovable/updates/lovable-launches-solutions-partner-program-for-agencies-and-consultancies ; partner-tools.lovable.app/portal/welcome ; affiliates.lovable.app/ ; alphasignal.ai/news/lovable-turns-800-000-freelancers-into-a-paid-partner-sales-force

Lovable's partner program has two tracks. The Solution Partner track is the revenue-share route, and the sources disagree on its exact tier structure.

- Solution Partner track: It covers agencies, consultancies, and system integrators. Partners earn revenue share on closed-won Business and Enterprise deals, receive credits, and are matched with enterprise buyers. It is for agencies, consultancies, and system integrators (typically 5+ people) selling to Mid market and Enterprise clients.
- Tiers conflict across sources: Lovable's own partner page lists four partner tiers. The rules site's Solution Partner page names Registered, Select, Premier, and Elite. Its Enterprise commission rates are 0%, 10%, 15%, and 20%, with Business subscription rates of 0% for Registered and 10% for the other tiers. A separate rules document describes three tiers, and a different reference page lists Registered, Premier, and Elite with 0%, 15%, and 20% rates. Treat the exact tier names and rates as unsettled.
- Qualification: Per the Solution Partner page, the thresholds include $120,000 Enterprise Sold ARR for the middle tier and $300,000 Enterprise Sold ARR for the top tier. Certification is measured by an Expertise Score ... out of 100.
- Expert track: This track is for smaller players. Experts earn 10% commission on every Business plan they bring to Lovable for 12 months.
- Program rules: Only enterprise subscriptions that are sold count as an eligible lead and toward tiers. Lead exclusivity is a 6-month window with case-by-case flexibility.
- Launch coverage: Earlier press coverage said the company has not disclosed specific commission structures, so it predates the detailed tier pages. A third-party summary says the old Lovable Experts program has been retired and folded into the new Solution Partner track. That conflicts with Lovable's own Expert page, which still describes the Expert track as live, so treat it as unverified.
- Unrelated referral page: A separate affiliates page offers 20% revenue share for 12 months on every customer you refer. It is not clearly part of the partner program, so I'd exclude it unless confirmed.
The most authoritative source is the Solution Partner Program Agreement, which the rules site says governs. I didn't find a dated official launch announcement, so the exact launch date is unconfirmed.

Lovable's current Expert track is open to individual freelancers and small agencies, with a free application and certification based on shipped work. One of the search results is an older page that conflicts with the rest.
- Eligibility: Experts are individual builders and small teams of less than 5 people, ideal for websites, apps, and internal tools. Larger firms go to the Solution Partner track, which requires a Business plan.
- Plan requirement: You need a paid plan. A Pro plan is all the Expert track requires.
- Application: Submit the form, and use the email of your main Lovable account, where you do most of your building. You will hear back by email within 5 working days with a decision.
- Certification: There is no exam. The assessment reviews published projects, traffic, and build-quality signals. Completing the Academy learning modules is also part of it. Two tracks exist, Website builder and App builder, and you can earn either or both.
- Cost: The program and certification are free.
- Benefits: Certified experts get a directory profile, and the program includes a 10% commission on referred Business plan subscriptions.
- Conflicting source: An older cached page at lovable.dev/experts says the Lovable Experts program is no longer active — it has been replaced by our Solution Partner Program. If you'd like to join, apply through the Solution Partner Program. The newer partner pages instead describe the Expert track as active, so the newer pages are the better guide.
- Terms: The Expert Program terms are dated August 2026 and say Lovable may change certification requirements at any time, so check the current criteria before applying.
